r8-sigma-once.title: Sigma priced ONCE at single site (crown)

r8-sigma-once.finding: grep confirms pool_random_effects appears in exactly one file (fit.py) and exactly one call expression, inside _price_sigma_with_shared_floor. INDEPENDENTLY reproduced by sabotage: added a second pool_random_effects call (feeding the first call's own output back in) -- test_shared_floor_priced_once_per_resolved_cell went RED (spy.call_count 8 != resolved_count 4, exactly the implementer's reported ratio) and test_helper_single_application_not_equal_to_naive_double_application also went RED (once no longer equals math.hypot(sigma0,shared_floor) once a hidden second application was folded in). Verified in fit.py source: shared_floor = math.sqrt(max(pool.var_circuit, 0.0)) where pool = fit_two_way(values, drivers_arr, classes_arr) -- var_circuit is the 'circuits' axis of TwoWayPool, and classes_arr is passed as the circuits argument, so this is genuinely the between-CLASS variance component, computed separately per channel (_fit_channel is called once per channel in the public entry point's loop).
